emails.notes: Biggest single fix in this round. Round 1's cross-funnel finding #1 said the 'adapts... how you're feeling changes' mechanism overclaim (voice.md's banned 'it adapts to what your body is telling it' framing) was fixed in every instance across Emails 2-5; Email 6's 'adapts as you progress' was left in and Round 1's own notes incorrectly called it 'already the accurate version.' Rewritten to the same physiotherapist-mapped-progression framing used everywhere else, worded differently per voice.md's 'repeat beliefs, rotate language' rule. Caught on a direct re-read against voice.md, confirmed by copy-editing and marketing-psychology. Subject line 'Got plans Monday?' has an untested but plausible Challenge-specific alternative ('Your Reset starts Monday') per ab-testing; not shipped, recorded as a test idea only.
